title: Coarse Frequency Compensator
text: Compensate for carrier frequency offset in PAM, PSK, or QAM, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Modulation type of input signal} sets Modulation type; {Estimation algorithm} sets the algorithm used to estimate frequency offset, {Frequency resolution (Hz)}, {Samples per symbol} sets the number of samples per symbol, {Maximum frequency offset (Hz)} sets the maximum measurable frequency, {Estimated frequency offset output port} sets the option to add estimated frequency offset output and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: Compensated output signal complex column vector

params.name: Modulation type of input signal
params.values: Modulation type QAM (default) | 8PSK | BPSK | OQPSK | PAM | QPSK

params.name: Estimation algorithm
params.values: Algorithm used to estimate frequency offset FFT-based (default) | Correlation-based

params.name: Samples per symbol
params.values: Number of samples per symbol 4 (default) | even integer greater than or equal to 4

params.name: Maximum frequency offset (Hz)
params.values: Maximum measurable frequency offset 5e3 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Estimated frequency offset output port
params.values: Option to add estimated frequency offset output port on (default) | off

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
